title: Deploy an App with a Manifest
description: Write a Deployment YAML from scratch and deploy it to your cluster.
problemStatement:
## 🎯 Goal
Create a Deployment named `web-app` that runs the `nginx:1.25` image with 2 replicas.

### Steps
1. Create a file `web-deploy.yaml`.
2. Set `apiVersion: apps/v1`, `kind: Deployment`.
3. Set metadata name: `web-app`.
4. Spec: `replicas: 2`, selector matching `app: web`.
5. Template labels `app: web` and container `nginx` image `nginx:1.25` with `containerPort: 80`.
6. Apply the manifest: `kubectl apply -f web-deploy.yaml`.
7. Verify:
   - `kubectl get deployments`
   - `kubectl get pods -l app=web` (should show 2)
   - `kubectl get replicasets` (should show one ReplicaSet)
8. Describe the Deployment and note the events.
hints: If you forget the YAML structure, use `kubectl create deployment web-app --image=nginx:1.25 --replicas=2 --dry-run=client -o yaml > web-deploy.yaml` as a starting point.
Make sure the selector in the Deployment matches the labels in the template exactly.
expectedOutput: Two Pods running, one ReplicaSet, and the Deployment status shows '2/2 ready'.
solutionCode:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web-app
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.25
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
